title: bugbot review translation
description: translate.json: the text of one round's review in review.language, written by the bot agent from findings.json before `bugbot publish`, in the PR's cache folder. Only what is posted is translated; findings.json stays in English (its titles are fingerprints). Code, identifiers, file paths and quoted rules are never translated. Any key left out falls back to English.

head.description: findings.json head: a translation of another round is refused.

tldr.description: The review's summary paragraph: what a reader must know first, in two sentences at most.

findings.description: Per finding id (F1, F2...): title and explanation in review.language.

text.description: Fixed strings of the review body, by key (heading, findings_line, findings_line_first, scope_line, pre_existing, plausible, rule, outside_title, outside_note, footer, pass_tldr, unchanged_tldr, approve_denied_status, approve_denied). Built-in languages (lib/publish/publish.py LOCALES) already have them; set a key only to override. Placeholders in braces stay as they are.
